PROJECTS_SUBTITLE: Hands-on labs & real projects built to learn by doing

PROJECTS.title: Terraform For Deploying Simple Frontend Backend App Using Docker AWS VPC ECR And ECS Fargate
PROJECTS.description: This project deploys a Flask backend and Express frontend using Docker and AWS ECS Fargate. Managed via Terraform, it features a VPC for isolation, an ALB for path-based routing, and ECR for image hosting. It includes secure private subnets, CloudWatch logging, and automated infrastructure as code (IaC) workflows.
PROJECTS.problem: App worked locally but broke in every other environment due to dependency mismatches.
PROJECTS.fix: Multi-stage Dockerfile + Docker Compose with named volumes and a shared bridge network. Image size reduced by ~55% using Alpine base.

PROJECTS.title: Flask Express Cicd Jenkins Github Webhooks Aws Ec2
PROJECTS.description: 🚀 Flask backend (port 5000) + Express frontend (port 3000) deployed on AWS EC2 with Jenkins CI/CD pipeline. Auto-deploys on every git push via GitHub webhook.
PROJECTS.problem: Manually creating VPCs was error-prone and took 30+ minutes per environment.
PROJECTS.fix: Reusable Terraform module with variable-driven CIDR blocks and AZ count. Full environment spun up in under 3 minutes with terraform apply.

PROJECTS.title: AWS Lambda Http Function Url Tutorial
PROJECTS.description: 📝 Learn serverless development with this AWS Lambda form handler! Submit forms → Store in DynamoDB → Display results instantly. Step-by-step tutorial included with complete code, IAM setup, and troubleshooting guide. Great for AWS beginners and serverless enthusiasts! 🎯
PROJECTS.problem: Deployments were manual SSH sessions — slow, inconsistent, and risky.
PROJECTS.fix: GitHub Actions workflow with job dependencies, AWS credential secrets, and rollback step on failure. Deploy time cut from 15 min to under 3 min.

PROJECTS.title: Terraform For Deploying Both Flask And Express On A Seprate EC2 Instances
PROJECTS.description: This Terraform script automates deploying a Flask backend and Express frontend on separate EC2 instances. It provisions VPC networking, security groups, and uses Nginx reverse proxy via user data for seamless inter-service communication. The modular design ensures isolation, scalability, and easy access through automated infrastructure outputs.
PROJECTS.problem: No visibility into server health. Apps would crash silently due to OOM errors.
PROJECTS.fix: Dockerized Prometheus + Grafana stack. Created custom dashboards and set up Slack alerts for high resource utilization. Detected memory leak within first 24 hours.

PIPELINE_YAML:
name: Deploy Portfolio Website            
  on:
    push:
      branches: [main]

  jobs:
    deploy:
      runs-on: ubuntu-latest
      steps:
        - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
          with: { node-version: '20' }
        - run: npm ci && npm run build
        - uses: aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials@v4
          with:
            aws-access-key-id: ${{ secrets.AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID }}
            aws-secret-access-key: ${{ secrets.AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY }}
            aws-region: us-east-1
        - run: aws s3 sync out/ s3://${{ secrets.S3_BUCKET }} --delete
        - run: aws cloudfront create-invalidation \\
                --distribution-id ${{ secrets.CF_DIST_ID }} \\
                --paths "/*"
